claim: A Multiple Sclerosis Journal study reported that DMF treatment response was associated with lymphocyte-subset changes, including disproportionate CD8+ T-cell reduction and altered CD4/CD8 ratio.
future_grounding_route: Use as source-specific composition-response context if validation cohorts include lymphocyte subsets; otherwise keep as external context only.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: V22 scalar is immune-tone bounded, not steroid/composition artifact

project_use: Sharper V50 source record for response-linked lymphocyte-subset composition as a potential confounder or diagnostic companion to transcriptomic validation.
relationship_note: This source strengthens the rationale for cell-composition adjustment in DMF response work, but it does not test whether the V22 scalar survives adjustment.

source.citation: Treatment response to dimethyl fumarate is characterized by disproportionate CD8+ T cell reduction in MS. Multiple Sclerosis Journal. 2017.
source.label: 2017 DMF treatment response lymphocyte-subset study

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: SAGE article page; metadata-only reuse in V50
source_terms.reuse_notes: V50 stores source metadata and a short paraphrased claim only.

why_unverifiable: The project has not imported the lymphocyte-subset data or tested whether these composition shifts explain the V22 scalar.
